intro: If you want a small boutique hotel with service that punches above its price and spacious, quiet rooms in Central Pattaya — Levana Pattaya Hotel, a 4-star butterfly-themed hotel open since 2015, is a name a lot of people bring up · The compact building of around 60 rooms on Central Pattaya Road Soi 4 has an 8th-floor sky pool looking out over the Pattaya cityscape, a Thai-Western restaurant, and free parking · Walk to JumpZ Trampoline Park and Harbor Pattaya, close to CentralFestival · From about ฿1,100/night on weekdays · Rated 8.9 from 354 Trip.com reviews and 8.8 from over 1,300 reviews on Agoda

body.html: Levana Pattaya overview — who it suits — To put it as simply as possible, Levana Pattaya Hotel is a small boutique hotel that plays the "value for money" card really well in Central Pattaya · It's not a beachfront resort with a big pool and sprawling grounds, and it's not a high-rise chain hotel where everything is standardized to the letter · Instead it's a 4-star butterfly-themed hotel of around 60 rooms that opened back in 2015 and is still running today, posting consistently good review scores · Real guest reviews line up on who fits here: couples, solo travelers, small families, and people who come to Pattaya often enough to know they don't need anything fancy — they just want a clean, spacious, quiet room and warm service at a price that isn't steep · Another group that says they were impressed is people who drive themselves, because free parking in Central Pattaya is rare and saves a lot · You could say Levana is a hotel that "doesn't sell flash" but sells simplicity done well, which is why a fair number of guests come back and mention it fondly · As for anyone hunting for a sea-view resort you can walk straight down to the beach from, or a hotel with every full five-star amenity, this may not be the answer, and they should look at beachfront hotels like Hilton Pattaya or Centara Grand Mirage instead

Location and getting around — Levana sits at 192/10 Moo 9, Central Pattaya Road Soi 4, Nongprue, in the Central Pattaya area set back a little from the main road · The upside of being down a soi is that it's quieter than hotels right on the beach road or near Walking Street, and many reviews say the same thing — they slept well, with none of the noise they'd braced for before arriving · For convenience, there are supermarkets, convenience stores, restaurants, and massage shops within walking distance of the hotel · JumpZ Trampoline Park is less than 100 meters away and Harbor Pattaya, the nearest shopping mall, is a short walk away · Pattaya Beach is about 1.2 km away, roughly a 15 min walk and a few minutes by car · CentralFestival Pattaya Beach and Terminal 21 Pattaya are also a short drive away · To be honest, one thing to note is that this isn't a hotel you can walk straight down to the beach from — some foreign reviewers say it's "a bit far from the beach," so if you plan to swim in the sea every day, keep that in mind · But for people who use Pattaya as a base to eat, sightsee, and shop, and who drive or grab a ride, this location works out nicely and saves money — and importantly, there's free parking, an edge that many hotels in this area don't have · U-Tapao Airport (UTP) is about a 40 min drive away, and from Bangkok it's about a 2 hr drive if you drive yourself

"The room was bigger than I expected, very clean, with strong hot water · What I loved most was the staff — fluent in English, helped with everything, and remembered us from day one · The soi was quiet, I slept great and never heard the road at all"

Room types and decor — Levana has around 60 rooms split into just a few tiers, which lets it look after everyone the way a boutique hotel does · It starts with the Superior Room at around 30 sqm, which counts as roomier than the standard rooms at many hotels in the same price range · Step up to the Deluxe Room at around 35 sqm, which is more spacious and gets good natural light · And the largest is the Suite Room at around 65 sqm, for families or anyone who wants plenty of space · Each room comes in both King and Twin bed setups · The decor follows the hotel's "butterfly theme" concept, in warm, easy-on-the-eyes tones that aren't garish · Every room has air conditioning, a fridge, a minibar (with some free items), an LCD TV with cable, a work desk, a safe, blackout curtains, free drinking water, and a bathroom with a shower and water heater · Many rooms have a private balcony · The point reviews praise most consistently is that the rooms are spacious, clean, and the beds are comfortable, especially for the price · Strong, steady hot water is another thing that comes up often · That said, to be straight about it, some reviews note that a few of the sheets and towels are showing their age and that a few rooms have a slightly musty smell because the building has been open since 2015 — details that can be fixed by asking to change rooms or telling the staff, and the team here responds to this kind of thing well

Facilities and the sky pool — Levana's most talked-about highlight is the 8th-floor sky pool that looks out over the Pattaya cityscape · It's a compact rooftop pool with a sun terrace for catching some sun, better suited to soaking, taking photos, and chilling out in the evening than to serious lap swimming · Sunset is the popular time when guests head up to sit and take in the city and the sky · You have to understand, in keeping with the small-boutique concept, that this pool isn't resort-sized — but in terms of atmosphere and the view it does better than you'd expect for a hotel in this range · Beyond the pool there's also 24-hour reception, free parking, free Wi-Fi everywhere, room service, tour and ticket booking, and a taxi call service · There's a meeting/event room for up to around 40 people, which makes it suitable for small seminar groups or family gatherings · What Levana doesn't have and you should know about is a large fitness center or a full-service spa like a five-star hotel — but given the location surrounded by massage shops and gyms in Central Pattaya, heading out to use those is easy and cheap · Overall the facilities here land at a "just right" level — the essentials are all there, with no extras padding the price

Food and bar — The hotel has an in-house restaurant serving Thai and Western food, plus a bar and snack bar · Breakfast is something many reviews mention positively, saying there's a fair range of choices and the taste is fine for a hotel this size — some room packages include breakfast, some don't, so check clearly when you book · Since it's a small boutique hotel, the restaurant isn't a big, varied buffet like a chain's, but leans more toward being friendly and cooking to order · What helps a lot is the Central Pattaya location, where a few minutes' walk gets you to Thai restaurants, seafood spots, international eateries, and convenience stores everywhere, so many people choose to eat out mostly and use the hotel's restaurant only for breakfast or an evening drink · The hotel bar suits a light drink after getting back from sightseeing more than being a destination for serious drinkers · In short, Levana's food isn't a reason to come and eat in the hotel primarily, but a nicely-judged add-on that fits the style of using the hotel as a base for exploring Pattaya

Service — This is where Levana scores highest and gets mentioned in nearly every review · Its service score on Trip.com is around 9.3, clearly higher than the other categories · Several staff are praised by name for being friendly, fluent in English, attentive, and good at solving problems on the spot · Many foreign reviews use phrases like "staff is amazing" or "great staff throughout" and say the team helps with booking tours, calling cars, recommending restaurants, and looks after you warmly from check-in to check-out · For a small boutique hotel, having staff who remember guests and provide personal care is a charm that many big chains can't offer · This is a key reason Levana's overall score is as high as 8.9 even though it's a small hotel not on the beach — because the service makes up for a lot of the limitations elsewhere

What real reviews say (praise and criticism) — Pulling from Trip.com, Agoda, and Booking.com, the picture is fairly consistent · On the praise side: excellent, friendly staff service, spacious and clean rooms, a quiet soi for easy sleep, strong hot water, the 8th-floor sky pool with city views, free parking, a location close to supermarkets and restaurants, and strong overall value for the price · On the things to note: the most mentioned is the distance from the beach — this isn't a hotel you can walk straight down to the beach from; you have to take a ride or walk about 15 minutes · Next is that the air conditioning in some rooms doesn't get fully cold or doesn't work at full capacity, a few sheets and towels are getting old, and a few rooms have a slightly musty smell given the age of the building, which has been open since 2015 · These criticisms are mostly things you can fix by telling the staff, choosing your room, and setting the right expectations, rather than big problems that keep people from coming back — you can tell from the still-high overall score and the regulars who return

"I've stayed here several times now, great value at this price · The only downside is it's a bit far from the beach, you have to take a ride down · But the rooms are clean, the rooftop pool has a lovely view, and the staff are sweet, so I come back every time I'm in Pattaya"

Price comparison and value — The starting price for a Superior Room is about ฿1,100/night on a low-season weekday (around 34 US dollars) and can climb to roughly ฿1,800–2,500+ on weekends, in high season, or over long holidays · Deluxe and Suite rooms run higher depending on size and timing · The average price travelers actually pay is around 55 US dollars per night · Compared with similarly-rated hotels in Central Pattaya, Levana feels great value among affordable boutique hotels, especially once you factor in the spacious rooms, the highly rated service, the sky pool, and the free parking that saves money in an area where parking is hard to find · Compared with Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central, a similarly-priced high-rise chain, Levana wins on room size and the quiet of the soi, but loses on the predictable chain standard and the newness of the building · For people who weigh value and warm service more than the brand and being close to the beach, every baht spent at Levana comes back in full

What to know before booking — A few things help the stay go more smoothly · One, check clearly whether the package you book includes breakfast, because some rates include it and some don't · Two, if newness of the room matters to you, ask for a Deluxe room or one that's recently been renovated, and give advance notice about sheets/towels or a musty smell if you're worried — the team responds to this well · Three, if you plan to swim in the sea every day, understand the hotel is about 1.2 km from the beach and you'll need to take a ride or walk about 15 minutes — if you can't accept that, choose a beachfront hotel instead · Four, anyone driving themselves has a big advantage because there's free parking in an area where parking is hard to find · Five, in high season and over long holidays prices climb fast and rooms fill quickly, so book ahead and compare prices across several platforms, and pick a free cancellation option up front if your plans aren't set

Summary — From all the real reviews, Levana Pattaya Hotel is the best fit for people who want a clean boutique hotel with spacious, quiet rooms and warm service in Central Pattaya, at an affordable price · The highly rated staff service, the 8th-floor sky pool with city views, the free parking, and the location near JumpZ and Harbor Pattaya make it hard to find a rival at the same price · If you're after a beachfront resort you can walk straight down to the sea from, or want every five-star amenity, this may not be the answer, and you should consider Hilton Pattaya or Centara Grand Mirage instead · But for a Pattaya trip where you want value-for-money lodging, good service, and a base to head out and eat, sightsee, and shop — Levana meets that need almost perfectly, and it's why it still holds a high score and has had regulars coming back for years

If you need full five-star amenities — there's no large fitness center or full-service spa, and the pool is a compact rooftop one → set your expectations on the service and value, or choose a large resort instead

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Levana Pattaya Hotel

faq.q: Where is Levana Pattaya Hotel · what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 192/10 Moo 9, Central Pattaya Road Soi 4, Nongprue, in the Central Pattaya area · JumpZ Trampoline Park is less than 100 meters away and Harbor Pattaya is a short walk away · Pattaya Beach is about 1.2 km away (~15 min walk) · CentralFestival and Terminal 21 are about a 7 min drive, and U-Tapao Airport (UTP) about 40 minutes · There's free parking

faq.q: What's the starting price at Levana Pattaya Hotel · what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about ฿1,100/night for a Superior Room of around 30 sqm on a low-season weekday · It climbs to ฿1,800–2,500+ on weekends and in high season · There's a choice of Superior (30 sqm), Deluxe (35 sqm), and Suite (65 sqm), in both King and Twin beds · Always compare several platforms before booking

faq.q: Does Levana Pattaya Hotel have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes, there's an 8th-floor rooftop sky pool overlooking the Pattaya cityscape with a sun terrace · It's a compact pool better suited to soaking, taking photos, and chilling in the evening than to serious lap swimming, and the atmosphere is best at sunset

faq.q: Who is Levana Pattaya Hotel for?
faq.a: It suits couples, solo travelers, and small families who want spacious, clean, quiet rooms and warm service in Central Pattaya at a good price · It's a great fit for people driving themselves because there's free parking · If you're hunting for a beachfront resort with a big pool, take a look at Hilton Pattaya or Centara Grand Mirage instead

faq.q: Is Levana Pattaya Hotel far from the beach · is it noisy?
faq.a: This isn't a beachfront hotel, about 1.2 km from Pattaya Beach, a ride or about a 15-minute walk away · But the upside is being down a soi that's quiet and easy to sleep in, and many reviews praise it for not having the road noise they'd expected before arriving

faq.q: What are the service and cleanliness like at Levana Pattaya?
faq.a: Service is the strongest point, with a service score on Trip.com around 9.3 · The staff are friendly, fluent in English, attentive, and helpful · Rooms are clean and spacious with strong hot water · One thing to note is that a few sheets/towels and some rooms are getting old with the age of the building, which opened in 2015 — you can tell the staff, and the team responds well
